description: This file contains classes and functions related to managing dashboard connections, tab control, and Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) sessions within the Playwright testing framework. It includes classes for DashboardConnection, CDPConnection, and utility functions for browser version retrieval.

classes.name: DashboardConnection
classes.description: Manages dashboard interactions, tab selection, navigation, and frame streaming for a browser context.

classes.name: CDPConnection
classes.description: Handles a Chrome DevTools Protocol session for a specific page, enabling command dispatch and event listening.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for a specific dashboard channel event.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes an event listener for a specific dashboard channel event.

methods.name: onconnect
methods.description: Initializes the connection, setting up browser and page contexts.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a method call to the underlying connection or page.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a tab by page ID.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes a tab by page ID.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates a new tab.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the selected page to a specified URL.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Navigates back in the browser history.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Navigates forward in the browser history.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the current page.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Simulates mouse move to specified coordinates.

methods.name: mousedown
methods.description: Simulates mouse button down at specified coordinates.

methods.name: mouseup
methods.description: Simulates mouse button up at specified coordinates.

methods.name: wheel
methods.description: Simulates mouse wheel scroll.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Simulates key down event.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Simulates key up event.

methods.name: _selectPage
methods.description: Selects a page and sets up event listeners for page events.

methods.name: _deselectPage
methods.description: Deselects the current page and cleans up event listeners.

methods.name: pickLocator
methods.description: Initiates element locator picking.

methods.name: cancelPickLocator
methods.description: Cancels element locator picking.

methods.name: _sendCachedState
methods.description: Sends cached frame and tab list state.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns a list of current tabs.

methods.name: _tabList
methods.description: Generates a list of tab information including URLs and titles.

methods.name: pageForId
methods.description: Finds a page by its ID.

methods.name: _pageId
methods.description: Returns the internal GUID of a page.

methods.name: _devtoolsUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for Chrome DevTools frontend.

methods.name: _pageInspectorUrl
methods.description: Constructs the inspector URL for a page.

methods.name: _sendTabList
methods.description: Emits the current tab list.

methods.name: _writeFrame
methods.description: Encodes and emits a frame of screencast data.

methods.name: getBrowserRevision
methods.description: Retrieves the browser revision string via CDP session.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a command to the CDP session.

methods.name: _initializeRawSession
methods.description: Initializes a new CDP session for a page.
